notes.title: Patch Update 🌧️
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We’ve just released a small patch with a few improvements to make your Devil’s Drizzle experience smoother. Nothing major this time, just polishing things here and there.

Thank you all for playing and for your amazing feedback, it really helps us keep improving the game! ❤️

notes.title: NEW VISUAL PROTECTION MODE
notes.content:
[h2]We’ve added a Visual Protection Mode to Devil’s Drizzle![/h2][p]This option removes certain visual effects from the screen to improve comfort for players with keratoconus or other types of visual sensitivity.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077437/ef3bcec9fbbe3eacd1940b05a90bab5c624532e0.png"][/img]
[/p][p]🔹 Can be enabled directly from the main menu.[/p][p]🔹 More accessibility, more comfort, more rain for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, and please keep sharing your feedback! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Visual Protection Mode
notes.content: Thanks to community feedback, we’ve added a Visual Protection Mode to the game. This option was created to provide more comfort for players with keratoconus, visual sensitivity, or other types of discomfort, making the gameplay experience more accessible and inclusive.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: We need to roll back one version to fix some bugs.

notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs related to SFX.
[*] Adjusted the balance of Hard difficulty.
[*] Added a photosensitivity warning at the start of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Final Boss Bug Fixed!
notes.content: Sorry for that, but now you can finish the game :)

We’re deeply grateful for all the support from the very beginning of development up to now. We wish everyone an amazing gameplay and hope you enjoy the experience we’ve created for you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐞Found a bug?[/b][/h3][p]

notes.title: Demo Updates
notes.content:
We've made several adjustments to the demo to enhance the experience. The key improvements include:

[olist]
[*] the introduction of difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard, with variations in the number of checkpoints per level and changes to boss mechanics
